title: Credit Risk
summary: A credit risk modeling project that segments applicants and analyzes thin-file (limited credit history) cases. It uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to fit on thin-file applicant data and generate 5000 synthetic profiles for data augmentation, run via sdv.single_table.
evidence: README.md:159-172 shows GaussianCopulaSynthesizer fit on thin_df and synthesizer.sample(num_rows=5000) to produce synthetic_data.to_csv(...)
